lines.meaning: Deformed Time, companion (copesmate) of ugly Night,

lines.text: Swift subtle post, carrier of grisly care,
lines.meaning: quick, sly messenger (post) carrying horrible (grisly) worry,

lines.text: Eater of youth, false slave to false delight,
lines.meaning: devourer of youth, and a disloyal servant of pleasures that are themselves deceptive,
lines.why: "False" is used twice, in two senses. The delight is false because it deceives, as it promises happiness and leaves regret. Time is a false slave because it is disloyal, as it hurries a person's pleasures along only to eat up the youth that enjoyed them.

lines.text: Base watch of woes, sin's pack-horse, virtue's snare;
lines.meaning: vile keeper (watch) of sorrows, a packhorse that carries sin's loads, a trap for virtue,

lines.text: Thou nursest all and murder'st all that are:
lines.meaning: you nurse everything into life and you kill everything that lives.

lines.text: O, hear me then, injurious, shifting Time!
lines.meaning: So listen to me, harmful (injurious), treacherous (shifting) Time!

lines.text: Be guilty of my death, since of my crime.
lines.meaning: Be guilty of my death, since you are guilty of the crime against me (my crime).

summary: Lucrece turns on Time, abusing it and holding it guilty of her rape and her death.
